gate_results: all numeric, structural, control, permutation and repeat gates pass
interpretation: a fixed nonlearned canonical-histogram KDE can recover the exact analytic score-flow mechanism on untouched synthetic palette distributions substantially better than hard case reuse or averaging
critical_limitation: the query histogram directly samples the target latent palette density; real film references instead conflate scene content with style, so the passed mechanism cannot yet be applied to photographs
next_ready_leaf: freeze a synthetic content-palette nuisance identifiability development experiment comparing raw KDE, distribution-matched density-ratio controls and a bounded parameter predictor before any image frontier
claim_ceiling: untouched synthetic confirmation of canonical-histogram KDE recovery for analytic palette-score diffeomorphic operators; never photograph, film, stock, preference, calibrated, production or unpaired-operator evidence
